target_text.text: Qatar's NDC emissions reduction target was previously defined as a projected percentage reduction by 2030 below business-as-usual (BAU) levels (an emission reduction target below a projected baseline). The target is consistent with Articles 4.3, 4.4, and 4.7 of the Paris Agreement, reflecting progression and the highest possible ambition, while acknowledging the role of international support in enabling implementation for developing country Parties. All national actions and plans described will be implemented in accordance with the principles and provisions of the UNFCCC, particularly Articles 4.7 and 12.4.

verdict.text: Qatar pledges a 25% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (condition not read). The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-11-21. It was read and refused, so the figure above comes from the First NDC (2021). 47 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (1). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 215.2 MtCO₂e, DS-35 149.2 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 25% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 52.2 for 2024. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.4°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.22°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
